pandas.plotting.scatter_matrix

pandas 3.1.1 · Plotting · function

    grid=False,

Example for a local Python session
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
frame = pd.DataFrame({"team": ["A", "A", "B"], "units": [2., 5., 7.], "price": [4., 3., 2.]})
print(pd.plotting.scatter_matrix(frame))
